name: cavemio-checkout
title: Checkout
description: A one-page checkout whose steps stack into a receipt: contact, address, delivery and your payment element, then Place order turns into the order number.

cavemio.accessibility:
- Steps are an ordered list; each finished one keeps a Change button, and focus moves into the next step when one is saved.
- Delivery speeds are a radio group with arrow keys; the country is the Select component, never the browser’s own dropdown.
- Saved steps and the placed order are announced from a status region; a refusal is an alert.
- Arrival dates are worked out once mounted, so the server render never shows a wrong day.
- Its light comes from your theme: the summary mixes --primary-foreground into --primary, line tiles take tints from --chart-1 to --chart-5, 1px edges throughout. No drop shadows, glow or blur.
- Built from Input, Select, Number roll, Status button and Text morph, which the CLI installs with it. No animation library; with reduced motion steps open and close in place.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: lines
props.description: – · { id, name, detail?, quantity, price, image?, icon? }: what’s being bought, on the summary.

props.name: deliveries
props.description: – · { id, label, detail?, price, days }: days from today, a number or [earliest, latest], shown as an arrival date.

props.name: onPlaceOrder
props.description: – · Gets { email, address, delivery, lines, subtotal, discount, shipping, tax, total }. Resolve with { number } to show it; throw an Error to say why not.

props.name: payment
props.description: – · Your provider’s element, shown in the payment step.

props.name: discount / taxRate
props.description: 0 / 0 · An amount off the subtotal, and tax on goods and delivery (0.2 for 20%).

props.name: countries
props.description: – · The country list; defaults to a short list.

props.name: currency / locale
props.description: "USD" / browser · Formats amounts and arrival dates.

useCases.title: Store checkout
useCases.description: The page after the cart, with your provider’s payment element inside it.

useCases.title: One-product sales
useCases.description: A product or course sold from its own page without a hosted checkout.

useCases.title: Pre-orders
useCases.description: Address and delivery taken now, payment captured when it ships.

useCases.title: B2B orders
useCases.description: A shipping address and delivery speed for a reorder, paid on invoice.

features.title: One surface, four steps
features.description: Only the step you’re on is open; finished ones fold into a line with Change, so nothing scrolls away.

features.title: Checked as you go
features.description: Email and the required address fields are checked when you continue, and each error sits on its field.

features.title: Delivery with dates
features.description: Each speed shows the day it arrives from its days, and the total rolls when you switch.

features.title: Your payment provider
features.description: Put its element in the payment slot; the block never touches card numbers.

features.title: Totals worked out
features.description: Lines, discount, delivery and tax (taxRate) add up on the lit summary; every change rolls.

features.title: The order number in place
features.description: onPlaceOrder resolves with { number } and the button becomes “Order HL-2048”; a refusal shakes and says why.

states.title: contact
states.description: The first step open with an email field and Continue; the rest wait as titles, and the lit summary shows the lines and the total.

states.title: step done
states.description: Continue checks the step; its body folds closed (440ms), its one-line summary opens under the title, a check draws in its number and the rail of light runs down (620ms).

states.title: shipping
states.description: Name, address, apartment, city, postcode and country (a Select); missing fields shake and say Required.

states.title: delivery
states.description: Speeds as a radio list with arrival dates (“Arrives Thu, Oct 23”) and price; picking one rolls Delivery and the total.

states.title: payment
states.description: Your provider’s element in the slot; Place order on the summary is enabled once the first three steps are done.

states.title: placed
states.description: Place order → Placing order → “Order HL-2048” with a drawn check; the steps lock and the note says where the receipt went.

states.title: declined
states.description: If onPlaceOrder throws, the button shakes into Try again and the message replaces the note.
